content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in early 30-day forecasts, especially after sharp spikes or volatility.
- Overestimates in the final 5–10 days of the 30-day window, particularly when true prices rise sharply (e.g., 70→75+).
- Tends to lag behind true price movements by 1–3 days, especially in upward trends.
- Overreacts to recent high volatility or spikes, overshooting the true peak by 1–2 points.
- Underestimates mean reversion in the final 5–10 days, failing to account for price pullback after initial surge.
- Forecasts show persistent downward bias in the first 10 days of the 30-day window, especially when history includes recent lows.
- Model exhibits “sticky” behavior — fails to adjust quickly to new data, especially when true price moves >1.5% from prior day.
- When true price rises >75% from 30-day mean, model often underestimates the magnitude by 5–10 points.
- Forecasts are overly conservative in the final 5 days, especially when true price is trending upward.
- Model fails to capture “late-stage momentum” — underestimates price acceleration in final 3–5 days of forecast horizon.
